name: Local Downloads
focusedTests: isolated application on all declared APK assets
combined application with Local Media and every current optional patch
TV AVD real transfer of a small direct progressive source for a series episode
acceptance: Settings > Morphe > Playback shows Allow local downloads above Show local storage in Library when both patches are installed

Local Downloads defaults off; enabling it reveals a native Maximum usable internal storage slider at 80%, with positions 1, 5, 10 through 100, the internal-storage caption, autoplay-local and Downloads rows
One unsectioned Local storage path row remains at the bottom whenever Local Downloads or Local Media is installed and is greyed and unfocusable only while both features are off
Local Downloads applies and runs without Local Media, and Local Media applies and runs without Local Downloads
Every title options dialog that contains Play manually also contains Download to storage while enabled
Selecting Download to storage opens Nuvio's existing manual source picker and consumes the resolved source without starting playback
Download mode remains active for every source selected in the same picker session and clears only after leaving that picker
Torrent, YouTube, HLS and DASH sources are rejected with a clear direct-source message
A source larger than the configured percentage of currently free storage is rejected before transfer, with smaller-source guidance

The progress popup reports bytes and percentage, identifies episodes as Title · SnnEnn, keeps movie titles unchanged, allows Hide to keep the foreground transfer running, and removes the partial file on Cancel
Cancel disconnects a source check that is still blocked and returns from Cancelling without waiting for the network timeout
Settings and progress both show one-decimal used/total internal GB followed by parenthesized percent full
A hidden successful download reopens the completion popup unless full-screen playback is active
Movies use a sanitized title folder; series episodes use a sanitized Title - Season n folder; addon subtitle sidecars share the video basename
Only addon subtitles matching Nuvio's preferred primary or secondary subtitle language are downloaded
Play local file appears for an exact downloaded title or episode and routes through Nuvio's player with catalogue identity preserved
Delete local file removes the exact downloaded video and indexed subtitle sidecars, removes the folder only when empty, and immediately removes its episode badge

Downloads lists only indexed Nuvio downloads with separated rows and a visible TV focus cursor; pressing an entry plays it, holding it opens Play and Delete actions, and Delete all downloads never removes manually copied files
Downloaded episodes show a native-feeling circular arrow-down badge at the top-right inset mirroring Nuvio's watched tick
Enabled movie detail pages show the arrow-down action immediately right of Watched using the same native spacing, selected colours and D-pad focus enlargement
The movie detail action opens a one-Back popup whose undownloaded state enters the existing source picker and whose downloaded state offers Play local file and Delete local file
Movie detail and Play long-press resolve downloaded movies by stable catalogue content id even when the selected source video id differs
Autoplay local storage when available replaces only an exact normal-play route and never changes manual source selection
Local Media recognizes both exact and language-tagged subtitle sidecars without depending on Local Downloads
No source URL or HTTP header is persisted after a download completes
No crash, ANR, VerifyError, leaked partial file or fatal log occurs during download, hide, cancel, completion or local playback
